items.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must support add/remove and event emission
items.desc: Claim Topics Registry should expose management functions and emit the standard add/remove events.
items.snippet: function addClaimTopic(uint256 _claimTopic); event ClaimTopicAdded(uint256 indexed claimTopic);

items.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for ClaimTopicsRegistry
items.desc: Identity Registry should wire the ClaimTopicsRegistry via setter and expose the stored address.
items.snippet: function setClaimTopicsRegistry(address _claimTopics);

items.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for TrustedIssuersRegistry
items.desc: Identity Registry must reference the Trusted Issuers Registry through the official setter.
items.snippet: function setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address _trustedIssuers);

items.title: IdentityRegistry must expose isVerified view function
items.desc: Identity Registry should implement isVerified and the token should point to the configured registry.
items.snippet: function isVerified(address userAddress) external view returns (bool);

items.title: Token must emit IdentityRegistryAdded and ComplianceAdded
items.desc: Token should emit events when wiring the identity registry and compliance modules.
items.snippet:
event IdentityRegistryAdded(address indexed identityRegistry);
event ComplianceAdded(address indexed compliance);

items.title: Token must support freezing and unfreezing addresses
items.desc: Token should include freeze management primitives required by ERC-3643.
items.snippet:
function setAddressFrozen(address _who, bool _frozen);
function freezePartialTokens(address _who, uint256 _amount);

items.title: Token must be ERC-20 compatible
items.desc: ERC-3643 tokens should fully implement the ERC-20 surface.
items.snippet: function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool); function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

items.title: Token must support investor recovery functionality
items.desc: Token should expose the recovery flow and emit the corresponding success event.
items.snippet:
function recoveryAddress(address _lostWallet, address _newWallet, address _onchainID);
event RecoverySuccess(address indexed _lostWallet, address indexed _newWallet, address indexed _investor);

items.title: Token must expose identity/compliance wiring functions
items.desc: The security token should wire and update the linked identity registry and compliance contracts.
items.snippet:
function setIdentityRegistry(address _identityRegistry);
function setCompliance(address _compliance);

items.title: Token must manage agent roles and emit events
items.desc: ERC-3643 requires agent role management on the token, including add/remove operations and audit events.

items.title: Token must support pause/unpause controls
items.desc: The token should be pausable with explicit pause/unpause functions and events for compliance oversight.

items.title: Token must emit freeze management events
items.desc: Freeze/unfreeze controls require dedicated events so operators can audit address-level freezes.

items.title: Token must support mint, burn, and forced transfers
items.desc: ERC-3643 tokens require controlled supply adjustments and emergency forced transfers.

items.title: Token must support batch administrative operations
items.desc: The token interface defines batch variants for transfers, freezes, mint/burn, and agent controls.

items.title: Token must expose investor identity metadata controls
items.desc: Token name, symbol, and on-chain identity must be mutable with corresponding audit event.

items.title: IdentityRegistry must manage agent roles with events
items.desc: Identity registry contracts also expose agent controls mirroring the token requirements.

items.title: IdentityRegistry must support identity lifecycle management
items.desc: Registering, updating, deleting, and batching identities are core ERC-3643 requirements.

items.title: IdentityRegistry must manage investor country data
items.desc: Country information drives jurisdictional compliance and must be retrievable and updatable.

items.title: IdentityRegistry must link IdentityRegistryStorage
items.desc: The identity registry should expose its storage contract, setter, and emit the linkage event.

items.title: IdentityRegistry must emit registry linkage events
items.desc: Changes to trusted issuers or claim topics registries must emit dedicated events.
items.snippet:
event ClaimTopicsRegistrySet(address indexed claimTopicsRegistry);
event TrustedIssuersRegistrySet(address indexed trustedIssuersRegistry);

items.title: IdentityRegistry must emit identity lifecycle events
items.desc: Investor identity creation, updates, and removals require auditable events.

items.title: IdentityRegistryStorage must provide identity storage primitives
items.desc: The storage contract should add, modify, remove identities and bind/unbind registries with events.

items.title: TrustedIssuersRegistry must cover issuer lifecycle
items.desc: Trusted issuers registry should add, remove, and update issuers and emit lifecycle events.

items.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must expose ownership controls
items.desc: Registry ownership transferability is required for governance handover.

items.title: Compliance contract must manage modules and transfer hooks
items.desc: Modular compliance must bind the token, manage modules, and expose hooks per ERC-3643.

items.title: Compliance contract must emit module lifecycle events
items.desc: Binding tokens and managing modules must trigger events for auditability.

items.title: Compliance contract must remain bound to the target token
items.desc: The modular compliance contract should report the audited token address.
items.snippet: require(compliance.getTokenBound() == address(this), "ERC-3643: compliance not bound");

items.title: Token's compliance pointer must match configuration
items.desc: The token should reference the expected compliance contract address.
items.snippet: require(address(compliance()) == expectedCompliance, "ERC-3643: unexpected compliance");

items.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must contain at least one claim topic
items.desc: A compliant deployment should define the minimum claim topics used for eligibility checks.
items.snippet: require(claimTopics.length > 0, "ERC-3643: missing claim topics");

llm.overallAssessment: The compliance audit reveals significant deficiencies in the implementation of ERC-3643 standards, particularly in the IdentityRegistry and Token functionalities. While some critical checks passed, numerous high-severity failures indicate a lack of essential features and controls.

findings.title: Transfer must check identityRegistry.isVerified
findings.explanation: The transfer to an unverified address reverted as expected, confirming that identity gating is enforced correctly.
evidence_paths: transfer(to=unverified) reverted as expected → indicates identity gating
findings.recommendation: Continue to enforce identity verification on transfers.

findings.title: Token must call compliance.canTransfer hook
findings.explanation: The compliance hook responded false as expected when forced, indicating proper integration of compliance checks.
evidence_paths: Probe module forced canTransfer=false via ComplianceProbeModule; hook responded false as expected.
findings.recommendation: Maintain the current compliance hook implementation.

findings.title: ClaimTopicsRegistry must support add/remove and event emission
findings.explanation: The absence of the addClaimTopic function in the ABI indicates a critical gap in functionality for managing claim topics.
findings.recommendation: Implement the addClaimTopic function to ensure compliance.

findings.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for ClaimTopicsRegistry
findings.explanation: The missing setClaimTopicsRegistry function in the ABI prevents proper linkage with the ClaimTopicsRegistry.
findings.recommendation: Add the setClaimTopicsRegistry function to the IdentityRegistry.

findings.title: IdentityRegistry must support setter for TrustedIssuersRegistry
findings.explanation: The lack of the setTrustedIssuersRegistry function in the ABI hinders the management of trusted issuers.

findings.title: IdentityRegistry must expose isVerified view function
findings.explanation: The isVerified function is missing from the ABI, which is essential for verifying identities.
findings.recommendation: Expose the isVerified function in the IdentityRegistry.

findings.title: Token must emit IdentityRegistryAdded and ComplianceAdded
findings.explanation: The absence of the IdentityRegistryAdded event indicates a failure to notify about critical registry updates.
findings.recommendation: Implement the IdentityRegistryAdded event in the token.

findings.title: Token must support freezing and unfreezing addresses
findings.explanation: The missing setAddressFrozen function prevents the token from managing address states effectively.
findings.recommendation: Add the setAddressFrozen function to the token contract.

findings.title: Token must be ERC-20 compatible
findings.explanation: The absence of the transfer function indicates non-compliance with ERC-20 standards.
findings.recommendation: Implement the transfer function to ensure ERC-20 compliance.

findings.title: Token must support investor recovery functionality
findings.explanation: The missing recoveryAddress function prevents investors from recovering their tokens, which is a critical feature.
findings.recommendation: Implement the recoveryAddress function in the token.
